sim.name: Baku. Post-FP2.
sim.version_description: With HAD returning to RED and LAW to VRB, we don't know what values F1 Fantasy will give them for R13 and R14 in the price change calculations. In this version of the sim, we assume the scores from their last active rounds: mean(rw10,rw11,sim) which results in balanced expected price changes based on the upcoming result and the performance of the drivers in their previous active rounds.
